question.text: Within what time frame from the date of the special resolution must allotment in a QIP be completed?

explanation.text: The Logic: Under SEBI ICDR, allotment pursuant to a QIP must be completed within 365 days from the date of the special resolution authorising the QIP. If not completed in time, a fresh special resolution is required. The Trap: 180 days is unrelated to the resolution-to-allotment validity period. The actual restriction on a subsequent QIP is a two-week gap between successive QIPs, not a six-month gap. Note: Keep the two timelines separate: 365 days is the validity of the special resolution for completing allotment, while a fresh QIP can be undertaken after a two-week gap from the previous QIP allotment.
